agents.name: Envoy
agents.description: A speaker for the house, sent to foreign courts with gifts, demands, and a purse for quieter purchases. Envoys travel openly and are never touched, whatever they carry.

agents.name: Spy
agents.description: A merchant's clerk, a wandering priest, a woman selling ribbons at the gate. Spies see what garrisons and builders are doing behind foreign walls, guard our own cities against the same, and can open a besieged gate from within.

agents.name: Assassin
agents.description: Poison, a knife in a doorway, a fire in a granary. Assassins remove foreign magistrates and generals and wreck what they cannot kill; their trade improves with every success and ends abruptly with most failures.
